answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in atlas and summit lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the dune graph. A farm of 4917 identities would post 3313 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
